title:
GitHub Issue Title:

Code Generation: Premature Implementation and Lack of Plan Modification Workflow
body:
**Bug Description**
Recently, I’ve noticed that Claude Code sometimes proceeds to make code changes directly, even when I specifically request only a plan. Additionally, in “planning mode,” there’s currently no way to review or modify the proposed plan before implementation.

**Suggestion:**
In Planning mode, please provide a clear option to review and edit the plan before Claude Code begins making changes. This would give users more control over the development process and help prevent unintended modifications.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 1.0.29
- Feedback ID: c1f570f6-0822-4607-b10a-a4dab3dab5d6
author: prasadgk
